div.head: Collected Qin Slips I: the Shuihudi bamboo slips
div.p: Chronicle: First year of King Zhuang.

div.head: Qin slips in the Yuelu Academy collection
div.p: In the time of the Grand Supreme Emperor the Clerk of the Capital said: The sikou, the yinguan and those serving their geng turn at the Western Workshop are many of them poor and cannot provide their own grain. Deliberation: Let the Counties send the sikou to deliver grain; where a County has no grain to be lent, let it report to the County of the work-site for repayment and loan. The Western Workshop fells timber in the hills of Ju and Nanzheng; let Ju and Nanzheng act on the Western Workshop's requisitions. Those who deliver the grain, and the officers, are passed on to the Western Workshop. · In the second year it was said: Put back in use.
